title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Deepak Gupta is the founding principal of Gupta Wessler LLP, the nation’s premier plaintiff-side appellate boutique. The firm specializes in arguing high-stakes cases in the U.S. Supreme Court and state and federal courts nationwide on behalf of plaintiffs and public-interest clients. Deepak has taught at Harvard for the past seven years. He currently co-teaches the […]
